maya: Quick kickoff — "Developer Ambassador Refapp Surge" week to push contributor signal and inbound demos. Goals: 750 repo stars, 140 webinar regs, 30 demo-qualified leads :sparkles:
maya: Primary tactic: recruit 10 dev ambassadors to publish walkthroughs + a 45m live workshop. Keep messaging practical & code-first.
amanda: Assets I'll run: launch blog, 3 micro-gifs (before/after latency), webinar landing + 3-email drip, ambassador promo kit (templates + assets).
jason: Tutorial checklist: fork -> run locally -> swap quantized model -> run perf script -> open PR. I'll add a tiny perf helper. Example for README:
```bash
python bench.py --model rdx-mini-q4 --prompt "hello" --reps 10
# outputs: mean,p95,p99,tokens
```
li: Benchmark blurb suggestions: 1) chat p95: local-q4 ~120ms vs hosted ~80ms; 2) embeddings throughput: local quantized 450/s vs hosted 1200/s; note: varies by hardware. Keep bullets short for blog.
sam: Lead form ask: add checkbox "Interested in Dedicated trial" and a free-text "primary use case" field. Also add utm_campaign=ambassador2026 to links for SDR routing.
bot-campaigns: campaign created: developer-ambassador-refapp-surge, landing draft: https://redwood.example/ambassador-surge (owner: maya)
maya: Proposed schedule: workshop Thu Jun 10 10am PT, dry run Tue Jun 8 11am PT. Action owners: maya -> blog + landing (Wed), amanda -> assets + email (Thu), jason -> tutorial + bench script (Wed), li -> benchmark bullets + slide (Thu), sam -> form + tracking (Thu). Keep status in this thread.
